column1: # Test recordings from the University of Iowa Musical Instrument Samples (https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/MIS.html).
# "Freely available ... may be downloaded and used for any projects, without restrictions." Downloaded at build time, not stored in the repository.
# Read by the downloadSamples task in app/build.gradle.kts and by SampleValidationTest. Paths are relative to
# https://theremin.music.uiowa.edu/sound files/MIS Pitches - 2014/ and the file name states the sounding note.
# kind: STEADY (no vibrato), VIBRATO, PLUCKED (dies away). transposition: the instrument's usual one in semitones.
# flags: octave-jump = the player's tone really jumps up an octave for a moment (checked by ear).
